vetSays.line: 🛡️ Paisley, Manuel, Blanca, Otieno and Gregoria met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Paisley, Manuel, Otieno, Gregoria are hurt.
🛡️ Paisley, Blanca, Otieno, Tariq and James met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Paisley, Blanca, Otieno, James are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Paisley just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Paisley, Blanca and Otieno met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Blanca is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Paisley just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Paisley, Manuel and Blanca met them at the door — 3 put down. Paisley, Manuel, Blanca are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Blanca just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Paisley, Manuel, Blanca and Otieno met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Paisley, Blanca, Otieno are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
🛡️ Paisley, Blanca, Otieno and Tariq met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Blanca, Otieno, Tariq are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Manuel just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Aibek and Ella met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Ella is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Nikolai was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Ella is showing everyone Ground Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ella just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ella met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
